description.value: Caffè Fantastico is a locally-owned, family-run coffee roastery based in Victoria that has been roasting sustainably sourced, high-quality beans since at least 2009. The Kings Road location is one of several in the city, operating as either the Roastery or bar-deli, and hosts regular community events including poetry slams, live music, and book launches. Touring cyclists will find a full café menu, takeout options including charcuterie boxes, and a community-focused atmosphere.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 75m; rack (covered) at 93m; rack (covered) at 95m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and corroborates the phone number (250-385-2326) and domain, but the footer across multiple subpages consistently lists the address as '965 Kings Road' while the OSM tag records '975 Kings Road' — a material discrepancy flagged in concerns. Takeout is confirmed via the prominent 'Order Take-Out!' navigation element and dedicated takeout menu items. No website evidence was found for bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM tag records '975 Kings Road' but the website footer across multiple subpages consistently shows '965 Kings Road'. The website value has been used in the address field.
Name discrepancy: OSM uses 'Caffè Fantastico' (with grave accent on the e), while the website consistently renders it as 'Caffe Fantastico' (no accent).

Multi-location business: Caffè Fantastico operates at least three Victoria locations (Roastery, bar-deli, TRE at the Parkside). It is unclear which specific location this OSM node represents; a second OSM node for another location may exist nearby.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established, community-focused coffee roastery and café in Victoria with confirmed takeout service — a useful stop for touring cyclists, pending resolution of the street number discrepancy.
